content.title: Leaving with our pets
content.summary: Keep a short evacuation routine on your household plan: who gets the pets ready, so they come with you.

sources.label: American Red Cross — Pet Disaster Preparedness

routine.title: Leaving with our pets
routine.thenTemplate: {who} puts cats and small pets in carriers and dogs on a secure leash or harness, or in a carrier, and they all come with us.
